## Lacuna contract

- [ ] Provenance remains exact and inspectable.
- [ ] Superseded claims remain queryable rather than being silently overwritten.
- [ ] Contradictory or missing evidence has an explicit safe outcome.
- [ ] Plans, questions and untrusted instructions cannot become authoritative claims accidentally.
- [ ] New metrics or integration claims link to reproducible evidence and state their limits.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused regression test added or the absence of one is justified.
- [ ] Relevant wider tests run.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` run for TypeScript changes.
- [ ] `npm run build` run for web changes.
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings added for visible changes.
- [ ] Documentation updated when public behaviour changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private workspace data or personal source material are included.
